FREE · FOR ADULTS 25+ NO ART SKILLS NEEDED

Draw it. Say it. Share it.

CREATE & CARE uses drawing, stories, drama and music to help adults talk about how they feel, find their people and take part in local life — in Bonn, Madeira and Eskişehir.

For adults 25+

Come for a cup of tea, leave with a story and new faces

You do not need to be “good at art”. Our local workshops are gentle, welcoming days where we use pencils, postcards, voice and simple movement to reflect on everyday life and connect with neighbours.

NON-CLINICAL ADULT LEARNING

Why art?

Talking straight about loneliness, stress or belonging can feel overwhelming—especially in a second language or a new stage of adulthood. Drawing a postcard, telling a story through an object, stepping into a playful role or sharing a rhythm gives people a side door into conversation.

This is a learning project, not therapy. Our facilitators are adult educators, not clinicians. We focus on creative expression, peer connection and active citizenship in safe community spaces.
12 educators trained across Germany, Portugal and Türkiye
60 adult learners, at least half with fewer opportunities
3 + 1 3 local exhibitions and one VR gallery
18 months together, Sep 2026 – Feb 2028
SEP 2026 – FEB 2028

The road trip

Eight stops across 18 months. Past stops are marked done, our current milestone is highlighted we are here, and upcoming stops await ahead.

  1. 01 Done

    Kick-off in Germany

    15–16 Sep 2026

    Project coordinators from Integrational e.V. (Germany), Associação Ramifica (Portugal) and Modern Gelişim Derneği (Türkiye) align the 18-month roadmap, safeguarding rules, evaluation instruments and outreach schedule.

  2. 02 Done

    Training course in Madeira

    9–15 Nov 2026

    12 adult educators (4 per country) spend a week in Madeira practising and co-designing safe, non-clinical creative workshops using drawing, storytelling, drama and music.

  3. 03 We are here

    Three local workshops

    Bonn 18 Jan, Madeira 19 Jan, Eskişehir 20 Jan 2027

    One-day creative adult education workshops for 60 adult learners aged 25+ (20 per city, at least half with fewer opportunities). Free to attend, no art skills required.

  4. 04 Upcoming

    Multicultural online hub

    10 Feb 2027

    Learners and facilitators from all three countries connect online to share artworks, stories and reflections across borders in a facilitated session.

  5. 05 Upcoming

    Methods Manual (4 chapters)

    1 Mar – 22 Apr 2027

    Co-authoring and publishing our practical 4-chapter Methods Manual covering drawing, storytelling, drama and music activities for adult mental well-being and inclusion.

  6. 06 Upcoming

    Four awareness campaigns

    May – Sep 2027

    Four thematic awareness campaigns challenging mental-health stigma and isolation among adults, complete with downloadable social and poster packs.

  7. 07 Upcoming

    Three exhibitions (3 weeks each) + VR gallery

    Oct 2027 – Jan 2028

    Three-week community exhibitions in each partner city showcasing consenting learners’ works alongside our permanent 3D virtual exhibition on Artsteps.

  8. 08 Upcoming

    Final conferences in three countries + final meeting in Eskişehir

    Feb 2028

    Live method demonstrations, publication of pre/post evaluation findings, local multiplier conferences in all three countries and final project meeting in Eskişehir.

EVALUATION & MONITORING PLAN

What we promised to change

Four measurable targets from our project Evaluation & Monitoring Plan:

+20% educators’ facilitation confidence
+20% learners’ motivation to take part locally
+30% awareness of mental health and stigma
+15% sense of belonging

Results are measured with pre/post surveys, reflection logs and focus groups across all three partner countries, and will be published openly on this website in February 2028.
